findings.title: 404 page ships without a stylesheet link
findings.description: New regression. Next 14 renders the not-found boundary outside every layout once an app has more than one root layout. Status is still 404 with noindex and the chrome was rebuilt inside not-found.tsx (nav, footer, font variables), but CSS arrives via the client chunk rather than initial HTML — brief unstyled flash.
findings.recommendation: Accept, or move to app/[locale]/ with a middleware rewrite to restore a single root layout.

findings.title: /ru/* misses render the English 404
findings.description: Same root cause — a RU-specific not-found.tsx would never be reached, so it was removed rather than left as dead code.
findings.recommendation: Accept, or address together with the item above.

findings.title: Still no Content-Security-Policy header
findings.description: Every other security header is present at the app level.
findings.recommendation: Add a CSP header in next.config.mjs or Caddy.

findings.title: x-powered-by: Next.js still exposed
findings.description: Unchanged from baseline.
findings.recommendation: Set poweredByHeader: false in next.config.mjs.

limitations: Local build, not production: no Caddy, no HTTP/3, no edge cache, no real network latency. Security headers were confirmed to originate in the app, so those carry over; TTFB numbers do not.
4 EN and 4 RU blog posts exist only on the live server (created through /admin), so content-depth and internal-link figures understate the real site. The 6 duplicate-H1 pages are among them.
claude-seo toolchain still unavailable (Python 3.9.6, no Homebrew): no Lighthouse, no screenshots, no PDF report.
No Google, DataForSEO, Moz or Bing credentials: no indexation, ranking, traffic or backlink data.
